changes.text: Freelook: hold Left Alt and look around without turning your character.
YA Cape: a white 3D cape with a thick edge and the black YA logo, worn by every YA player.
Store redesigned in the pixel style of the website.
New launcher built without Electron: one small .exe that updates itself.
Sections: Play, Mods, Servers, Settings, Console and Logs.
First-run setup for your account, mods and memory.
News with pictures and official partner servers on the launch screen.
Keystrokes: colours, size, corners, outline, opacity, sprint and sneak keys.
Draw your own crosshair on a pixel grid. The default Minecraft one hides automatically.
Nick Tag and tab logo for players using YA CLIENT.
Search box in the mod menu.
1.7 animations: blocking, bow and eating swing.
Redesigned title screen, singleplayer, multiplayer, pause and options menus.
Server pictures in the multiplayer list.
Clean loading screen with only the logo and a progress bar.
Leaving a server now returns you to the multiplayer list, and Back goes to the home screen.
